text: およぎ　なら　うみの　ポケモンにも　まけない！

structure.jp: うみの　ポケモンにも

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a thing says 'if we are talking about that'. およぎ　なら = 'when it comes to swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜にも
patterns.explanation: に shows who you would lose to, and も adds 'even'. ポケモンにも = 'even to Pokémon'.
